# Vocabulary: horizon

Expected time until meaningful use in shipped simulation games, as judged at the entity's last review date.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `now` | Now | Usable in a production title started today. |
| `1-2y` | 1-2 years | Needs one more generation of cost, latency, or tooling improvement. |
| `3-5y` | 3-5 years | Needs research progress plus tooling. |
| `5y-plus` | 5+ years | Speculative; depends on unsolved research problems. |
